index_retenu.requete: SELECT equipment_id, timestamp, value FROM sensor_readings WHERE sensor_name = 'vibration_mm_s' AND value > 5.0 ORDER BY value DESC

avec_index.plan: SEARCH sensor_readings USING INDEX ix_sensor_readings_sensor_value (sensor_name=? AND value>?)

sans_aucun_index.plan: SCAN sensor_readings | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

index_ecarte_apres_mesure.requete: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(value) FROM sensor_readings WHERE equipment_id = 'EQ-FAN-304' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-05-01 00:00:00+00:00' AND '2026-05-31 23:59:59+00:00'

index_unicite_seul.plan: SEARCH sensor_readings USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_sensor_readings_1 (equipment_id=? AND timestamp>? AND timestamp<?)

index_ecarte_apres_mesure.conclusion: redondant avec sqlite_autoindex_sensor_readings_1, cree par la contrainte d'unicite sur (equipment_id, timestamp, sensor_name)
